name: couchtisch
assumptions: The 19 cm dimension runs from the tabletop underside to the shelf top; the 20 cm dimension from the floor to the shelf underside. The small gap between them is the shelf thickness.
Shelf thickness 10 mm (not dimensioned); top thickness follows from 450 - 190 - 10 - 200 = 50 mm.
Legs are 50 x 50 mm and flush with the tabletop edges.
Shelf spans between the inner leg faces along the length and uses the full table depth.
ambiguities: The extension lines of the 19/20 cm dimensions are drawn at a back leg in perspective; the start of the 19 cm line could also be the tabletop surface, which would not add up to 45 cm.
The shelf support brackets visible under the shelf centre are not dimensioned and are omitted.
